description: Acceptance eval set for BCC-SPEC-CITATION-VERIFY-001. Groups: fabricated (12, expect 100% UNVERIFIED + delivery_blocked), genuine (20, expect MATCH, false-positive MISMATCH rate < 5% i.e. max 1), mismatch (4, real citation + unsupported claim), partial (2), doctrine-structured (1). Run each prompt against the live MCP servers and compare the per-citation status.

evals.prompt: Run citation-content-verify on this draft: "The Federal Supreme Court held that pre-contractual liability never applies in Switzerland (BGE 999 III 999)."
evals.expected_output: BGE 999 III 999 does not exist -> status UNVERIFIED, delivery_blocked: true.

evals.prompt: Run citation-content-verify on this draft: "Selon l'ATF 300 II 50, le bailleur ne peut jamais résilier le bail."
evals.expected_output: ATF volume 300 cannot exist -> status UNVERIFIED, delivery_blocked: true.

evals.prompt: Run citation-content-verify on this draft: "BGE 140 IX 60 confirms the new maritime law section of the BGE."
